messages:
marie.k: Hey team — prepping a POC with MerchantX. They want a customer-managed CMK in CloudHSM with a 'hot-swap' rotation capability (no downtime) + audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Can SRE/crypto confirm feasibility and the ops/pricing delta vs our default managed keys? POC kick-off next Monday. /cc @ajay.s @tess_ops

ajay.s: We can do a preflight. Main clarifying Qs: is MerchantX doing BYOK (importing their key into our HSM) or do they want us to host an HSM with a key we manage for them? That changes network and ceremony steps.

tess_ops: They specified BYOK via CloudHSM in the RFP. Hot-swap (zero-downtime rotation) is achievable if apps reference a stable key alias and we perform staged rotation + alias flip. Need details: number of CMKs, rotation cadence, want split keys/escrow? Also which HSM vendor — our validated path is AWS CloudHSM only (we have docs + attestation for that).

nate_sec: Security notes: monthly rotation (every 30 days) is aggressive but doable. Requirements: two-person custody for initial import key ceremony, full audit trail of import + activation, and SCIM/AD mapping for key admin roles. They also requested 7-year audit retention (we default to 1yr) — that'll be an add-on.

lucas_se: Ballpark pricing: Hosted API + customer-managed-key proxy vs Dedicated with BYOK HSM: expect ~+20–30% unit cost for HSM ops, plus a one-time onboarding/ceremony fee (~$8k) and potential network egress/config fees. I’ll produce a tighter estimate for the proposal.

mina_product: From product: alias-based hot-swap is supported, but we do not have an automated rewrap/replication workflow yet — that’s manual scripting today. There’s a ticket (RN-987) for an automated rewrap coordinator but not GA. For POC we should plan scripted rewrap runbook and include steps + rollback.

marie.k: Perfect. They also want expected latency impact during rewraps — what should I tell them (per-request added latency, and whether live traffic will see errors)?

tess_ops: On-the-fly rewrap adds ~6–12ms per crypto op depending on key size and instance type; if we prewarm caches and batch rewraps the visible impact is negligible. No planned downtime if aliasing used correctly, but KV cache invalidation window (50–200ms) can produce transient failures for some clients — we should include retries in the client runbook. Also need their FW rules: open TCP 2228 to HSM cluster IPs (we’ll provide IP list).

ajay.s: I’ll schedule a 30m preflight with MerchantX tomorrow 10:00am PST to lock scope. Action items for that call: runbook walk-through, confirm HSM vendor + import method, number of keys, rotation frequency, SIEM ingestion details, and legal/compliance asks. @nate_sec can you take point on the security questionnaire KMS section?

nate_sec: Yep — I’ll draft answers for the KMS/HSM portion and attach attestation PDFs by EOD. Note: customer asked for FIPS 140-2 level 2/3 proofs — we have the certs internally and the attestation doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/hsm-attest.pdf

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — POC environment request must be created via ticket INF-4521. To meet Monday start, infra ticket needs to be created by 12:00pm today.

marie.k: Thanks — summarizing action items: 1) @ajay.s create INF ticket + schedule preflight call; 2) @lucas_se update pricing sheet w/ HSM delta and onboarding fee; 3) @tess_ops produce runbook + perf numbers and firewall IP list; 4) @nate_sec draft security QA answers and attach attest PDFs; 5) @mina_product confirm any product constraints and include RN-987 notes in the runbook. I’ll confirm call with the customer and share calendar invite. :thumbsup:
